scripts.build: npm run -w front-end build && npm run -w back-end build
scripts.lint-server: npm run -w back-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end server
scripts.lint-serve: npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w front-end serve
scripts.lint: eslint "scripts/**/*.mjs" && npm run -w front-end lint && npm run -w back-end lint
scripts.lint-fix: eslint "scripts/**/*.mjs" --fix && npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end lint-fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w front-end typecheck && npm run -w back-end typecheck
scripts.test: npm run -w front-end test:unit && npm run -w back-end test:unit
scripts.validate: npm run check:native-bindings && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:repo && npm test && npm run build
